commands.label: Model Family
commands.description: Which file family this GGUF belongs to. Detected from the file; set it by hand only for a fine-tune Strata does not recognise.

commands.label: Model Variant
commands.description: Which quantization variant of the family this GGUF is. Detected from the file.

commands.label: Image Input
commands.description: Let the model read images. yes/gpu puts the encoder on the GPU (about 1.4 GB VRAM), cpu keeps it in RAM.

commands.label: Image Tokens
commands.description: The most image tokens one picture becomes. More reads small text and charts better but encodes slower.

commands.label: Context Size
commands.description: Context window in tokens. Left empty, setup picks the recommended size for this GPU and RAM.

commands.label: KV Cache Precision
commands.description: KV cache precision above 8K context (up to 8K it is fp16). int8 is Strata's name for the 8-bit KV cache that llama.cpp calls q8_0: the same thing, so the web UI may show "q8_0" for it. q4_0 is 4-bit (Hadamard-rotated, half the memory); k8v4 stores K as 8-bit and V as 4-bit.

commands.label: KV Streaming
commands.description: From a 64K context, keep the KV cache in RAM and only the attention window in VRAM, so more experts fit on the GPU.

commands.label: RoPE Scaling
commands.description: Context extension used past the trained 262144 tokens. Left empty, setup picks yarn for such a context.

commands.label: RoPE Scale Factor
commands.description: Extension factor. Default: the final context over 262144, at least 1.

commands.label: GPU Backend
commands.description: cuda = NVIDIA, hip = AMD, sycl = Intel Arc (experimental, Linux). Left empty, setup chooses by itself.

commands.label: GPUs
commands.description: Several GPUs sharing one model, as nvidia-smi numbers them: "0,2" or "all". The first is the main one.

commands.label: Single GPU
commands.description: Use one specific GPU, numbered as nvidia-smi numbers them.

commands.label: Layer Split
commands.description: With several GPUs: where each later GPU's layers start ("18" or "16,32"). Default: placed from each GPU's free VRAM.

commands.label: VRAM Reserve (MiB)
commands.description: VRAM the engine leaves free for other programs. The expert cache takes that much less.

commands.label: Parallel Requests
commands.description: Up to N requests decode together. Each slot takes VRAM from the expert cache. 1 means one at a time.

commands.label: Low-RAM Mode
commands.description: Read the experts from one file instead of copying them all into RAM, for a PC with a big GPU and little RAM. auto decides from the RAM size.

commands.label: Resident Budget (GiB)
commands.description: For the Unsloth variants: the GiB of experts kept in RAM. Default: the RAM less 24 GB.

commands.label: Draft Vocabulary
commands.description: The draft layer's tokens. cjk is the default, en saves about 110 MiB of VRAM, cyrillic and fr add those scripts.

commands.label: Speed Projection (Experimental)
commands.description: Experimental control vector applied as a projection on layers 4-44. Off by default.

commands.label: Server Host
commands.description: Where the server listens. 127.0.0.1 is this PC only, 0.0.0.0 also other devices on the network (set an API key too).

commands.label: API Key
commands.description: Require this key from clients. Several keys: key1,key2.
